filter: UP on cool CPI/PPI beats, rising jobless claims above 203K, weak retail sales, or soft UoM sentiment. DOWN on hot CPI/PPI surprises, claims below 199K, or hawkish Fed commentary post-print.
phase: Gold is in a high-stakes inflation-data inflection point midweek. The dominant force is tomorrow's US CPI print (Aug 12), where forecasts call for Core CPI at 0.2% m/m / 2.5% y/y and headline CPI at 0.1% m/m / 3.4% y/y — a modest cooling from prior readings. The Fed remains data-dependent and on hold; any upside CPI surprise cements higher-for-longer and pressures gold, while a cool print reopens the rate-cut narrative and is bullish. The tilt is two-sided but with a slight bearish lean into the number given recent hot-surprise reactions (-1.09% to -2.33% on prior hot prints). Key risk: a stagflationary read (hot CPI + weak growth signals) could produce a whipsaw. Geopolitical backdrop remains a secondary support floor.
